S&P Global Ratings upgrades RTX to A- on strong demand and debt reduction
summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded Rtx Corp's (NYSE:RTX) issuer and unsecured issue-level credit ratings to ‘A-’ from ‘BBB+’ on Friday, citing robust aerospace and defense demand alongside steady balance-sheet repair. The agency assigned a stable outlook and affirmed RTX’s ‘A-2’ short-term rating, projecting that the company will keep adjusted debt to EBITDA below 2.5x and funds from operations to debt above 30%.
